dct_creator_sm: Philippe Archambault (Université Laval, Québec-Océan, Biology Department, Laval University).
dct_description_sm: Data were collected as part of the Environment & Marine Resources Component of a large collaborative effort linking ArcticNet, BP Exploration Operating Company Limited (BP) and Imperial Oil Resources Ventures Limited (IOL), aiming to assess spatiotemporal variability of the main compartments of the pelagic and benthic food webs (Environment & Marine Resources Component), sea-ice coverage (Met/Ocean & Sea Ice Component), as well as seabed characteristics (Geology/Bathymetry Component) in and around Exploration License Areas 446, 449, 451 and 453.  The general goal of the Environment & Marine Resources Component was to map and describe the summer distribution and baseline contamination of the main compartments of the pelagic and benthic food webs along the slope of the Mackenzie Shelf, from the inner shelf (50 m) to the margin of the deep basin (approx. 1000 m), and along the shelf on an East-West gradient in the Exploration License Areas.   The objective of the benthos program was to characterize the abundance, spatial variability in the distribution and diversity of benthic organisms (endobenthic and epibenthic fauna).
dct_title_s: Benthic data from the environment and marine resources assessment of Imperial Oil/BP Exploration License Areas 446, 449, 451 and 453 (Beaufort Sea), in the summers of 2009, 2010 and 2011
